name: Rurika Ordet
source:
A character from the London chapter.

Hobby: Creative activity.
Favorite food: Her own creative cuisine (A combination of British and Japanese cuisine, such as natto muffins).
Hated food: Mille-feuille.

Class 1-C. She is [url=/c10688]Ian Selway[/url]'s maid.
